title: Integral constructible pullback has a coefficient-linear right adjoint
statement: Let K be a field with l invertible, E a finite extension of Q_l, and f:X to Y a morphism of finite-type K-schemes, without separatedness. The recorded constructibleIntegralPullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] has a right adjoint R on the full intrinsic integral constructible categories. The functor R is additive and O_E-linear. This is an integral universal-property statement, before rationalization, common-stage descent, scalar-change mates or Weil lifting. The right-adjoint object with its adjunction is determined up to its unique counit-compatible natural isomorphism.

source.place: 6.5.9 and Lemma 6.7.2; Stacks Project Tag 099N(2), normalization on complete constructible categories

proof.text: Compose the actual whole-system reduction/limit adjunction with systemAdjunction for the sectionwise derived direct image. The reconstruction unit is invertible on constructible complete objects. For a fully faithful inclusion i and an adjunction S ⊣ T whose unit is invertible on i, define the inverse on Hom of i followed by S by the adjunction homEquiv followed by the inverse unit, then the full inclusion preimage. The unit naturality and triangle equations prove both inverse identities. This fully faithful reduction argument is proved explicitly in Lean.

The actual normalized integralComparisonPullbackCounit is invertible on constructible objects by effective pullback. Its inverse identifies the included constructible pullback followed by reduction with reduction followed by strict system pullback. Apply Mathlib Adjunction.restrictFullyFaithful using the full inclusion on the source, the just-proved fully faithful reduction on the target, and this comparison. The right functor is literally directImageFunctor, with identity comparison, so no arbitrary right-adjoint data are selected. The existing directImage_linear gives additivity and O_E-linearity.

lean.statement:
theorem sfIntegralPullbackLinearAdjunction
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (K₀ : Type u) [Field K₀] (hl : IsUnit (l : K₀))
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of K₀))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of K₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of K₀))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of K₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of K₀))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of K₀))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of K₀))]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)] :
    ∃ R : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X ⥤ sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y,
      Nonempty (constructibleIntegralPullback l E f ⊣ R) ∧ R.Additive ∧
        R.Linear (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)
